nodes.name: Gumroad sales page 1
nodes.notes: Read-only. Token lives in n8n env, never in the workflow.

parameters.content:
## Gumroad -> Airtable
Schedule every 6h: `GET /v2/sales` -> dedupe by `sale_id` -> Airtable upsert.
Reruns are safe: the same sale never creates a second row, and a refund later flips `refunded` on the existing row.
Set `GUMROAD_TOKEN` (read-only scope) + `AIRTABLE_BASE_ID` as env vars; the Airtable PAT is a credential, not a parameter.
